minimal_toolkit_v0_1.name: testing/CANDIDATE_MINIMAL_TOOLKIT_v0.1.md
minimal_toolkit_v0_1.role: non-authoritative inventory of tiny deterministic helpers and ambient semantic reminders
minimal_toolkit_v0_1.implementation: documentation/test surface only; no implementation mandate
minimal_toolkit_v0_1.authority: none by default; tool pass/failure establishes only the structural condition each tool is designed to test

source_selection_note: v2.5 externalizes Environment and Temporal Notepad provenance/changelog comments while preserving operational semantics. This repository stores the clean current owners once under policy/ and retains historical diffs separately under verification/.

index.md.mutation: rewrite when current routing or load-bearing anchors materially change
index.md.authority: pointer/summary only; defer to exact policy sources when exactness matters

state.json.mutation: rewrite when material current state changes
state.json.authority: current local projection; not source state or historical record

contradictions.jsonl.authority: observation history; disposition does not erase prior observation

events.jsonl.authority: observable event history, not behavioral scoring or semantic state owner

telemetry/.role: passive append-only raw model/runtime observations; separate from project events and semantic state
telemetry/.mutation: append observations only; corrections append via supersedes_observation_id; contract changes remain explicit
telemetry/.authority: provenance/observation only; no judgment, scoring, authorization, causal-diagnosis, identity, successorship, or semantic-state authority

policy/.role: canonical current Environment / Temporal Notepad owner artifacts plus manual combined calibration source and external changelog
policy/.mutation: replace only when a later current source package is deliberately adopted
policy/.autoload: no; retrieve exact source when load-bearing
policy/.authority: source artifacts retain only their own bounded semantics; repository presence adds no authority

verification/.role: release verification, lineage, reviews, and historical diffs
verification/.mutation: append or replace only as release evidence requires

testing/.role: non-authoritative candidate mechanisms/reminders under ordinary-use testing
testing/.mutation: change only when ordinary-use testing exposes an inadequacy or a demonstrably simpler sufficient form
testing/.autoload: no; retrieve only when candidate-toolkit testing is relevant
testing/.authority: testing/orientation only; not semantic owner, controller, behavioral score, or implementation duty

manifest.json.role: deterministic structural inventory and source hashes
manifest.json.mutation: rewrite when project structure/source anchors materially change
manifest.json.autoload: only when structural semantics/provenance are needed

retrieval_policy: current decision boundary / material hinge determines deeper retrieval
memory availability does not create retrieval duty
use a representation sufficiently rich for the current boundary
do not silently reuse a prior projection for a new boundary
prefer exact/current source over summary for consequential transitions
stop when more context cannot change the next material action, requisite evidence/authorization, material risk, or stop condition
graph_policy: keep relationships implicit in ordinary IDs/links/hashes until observed navigation/query friction makes explicit graph machinery load-bearing
design_bias: progressive disclosure; non-collapse; preserve provenance/currentness; no proceduralization without observed need
mutation_rule: change the sandbox only when ordinary work exposes material friction, failure, stale-state risk, or a demonstrably simpler sufficient form

packaging_repair.reason: merge mini sandbox runtime with v2.5 calibration/policy package as one repository project and remove duplicated embedded source/provenance surfaces
packaging_repair.change: single canonical policy surface + verification/history surface; old repository working tree ablated
